protocol: 50-seed paired evaluation of six frozen controllers

predeclared_contrasts.label: PRIMARY: final v3 vs initial v3

interpretation_limit: Controllers were frozen before this cohort was evaluated. The cohort is held out from the documented strategy-development runs, but was selected after the policies were frozen rather than preregistered before authoring. Results estimate performance on this fixed cohort and do not prove universal superiority or explain causation.
